dashboard.label: TA-ups Overview
dashboard.description: Collects UPS health from Network UPS Tools (upsc) or apcupsd (apcaccess) when a UPS server is reachable: device model, online/off-battery status, battery charge, load and input

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ups:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="ups.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="ups:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
